entities.name: Early Amerindian and Arawak Settlement
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Amerindian peoples, likely originating from Venezuela's Orinoco region, first settled Barbados around 1600 BCE. Later Arawak agricultural communities developed village sites, cultivated cassava, and established trade networks with neighboring islands.
